language.description: Language ISO code (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes). Currently we accept the following values: es (Spanish), it (Italian), pt (Portuguese), en (English), de (German), fr (French), ru (Russian), zh (Chinese), ca (Catalan), fi (Finnish), nl (Dutch), pl (Polish), ro (Romanian), sv (Swedish), da (Danish), nb (Norwegian), el (Greek), uk (Ukraine)
